offers_products.reason: Main offering is lease-to-own financing and rental; goods are leased, plus Brigit app, rather than sold as manufactured products.

offers_services.reason: Lease-to-own financing via Acima and Rent-A-Center, plus Brigit's financial health app and cash advances, are financial services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Rent-A-Center, Acima and Brigit serve individual consumers leasing furniture and appliances or using the finance app.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Acima partners with thousands of retailers and RACFI has franchisees, but consumers remain the main buyers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Weekly or monthly lease payments on rented goods and Brigit subscriptions generate ongoing revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Customers are lower-credit households renting necessities like furniture and appliances; demand tends to hold up in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Customers make small weekly or monthly lease payments, though the underlying goods are durable.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from leased merchandise, lease technology platform and app, not mainly staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households; retailer partners and franchisees are secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs large lease merchandise inventory and many Rent-A-Center stores; Acima also buys goods from retailers to lease.

notes: Rental and lease-to-own is the larger business; products-versus-services classification is judgment-based.
